handoff.purpose: Complete official-source requirements for XTU's 76 Fall 2026 master and doctoral routes; exclude unresolved undergraduate CSCA bindings.

unresolvedNotes: Scope contains all 76 official master and doctoral routes in the acquired XTU catalog.
Twenty undergraduate routes are excluded because the route-specific CSCA subject attachment is protected by a download captcha and its exact subject bindings could not be independently acquired.
This historical Fall 2026 cycle is closed and must not be shown as current.
The scholarship record remains independent; no route-level entitlement is inferred.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen age 18 or above, physically and mentally healthy, able to perform academically, compliant with Chinese laws and university rules, and respectful of Chinese culture. Applicants covered by the published former-Chinese-citizen rule must also satisfy its passport and overseas-residence conditions.
Hold a bachelor's degree and be under age 35.
Register in the Xiangtan University International Students Service Platform, complete the online form and submit the application.
Submit a copy of the passport home page and renew the passport first if it does not satisfy the published validity requirement.
Submit a notarized highest diploma; prospective graduates submit official student-status proof. Add notarized Chinese or English translations when required.
Submit sealed academic transcripts covering all applicable study stages, with notarized English translations for documents in other languages.
HSK Level 4 or above; the published native/official-language or prior Chinese-medium education exemption may apply.

references.locator: Eligibility item 4 and Application Documents item 4, pages 2 and 4-5

requirements.ruleText: Submit a Chinese- or English-language study plan explaining educational background, understanding of China and the chosen major, and study goals.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form in English with the blood-test report, completed after October 1, 2025 and satisfying the published signature, stamp and photograph rules.
Submit a valid non-criminal-record certificate issued by the local public security authority after October 1, 2025.
Submit two Chinese- or English-language recommendations from professors or associate professors, each with the recommender's contact information and dated after October 1, 2025.
Submit a self-introduction video covering educational and professional background and research potential; the file must be under 50 MB.
Submit a bank-deposit certificate sufficient to cover at least one year of study and living costs in China.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who have an XTU supervisor recommendation
requirements.ruleText: Submit the XTU Supervisor's Recommendation Form when applicable.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with publications or other academic evidence
requirements.ruleText: Submit published papers and other academic supporting materials when available.
Provide notarized Chinese or English translations for materials in other languages and ensure every document is authentic and complete.
Submit the self-funded degree-program application by April 30, 2026. Scholarship deadlines are controlled by their corresponding notices.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 18,000/year.

Budget for insurance at CNY 400 per semester or CNY 800 per year. Published on-campus accommodation is CNY 600 per month for a double room or CNY 900 per month for a single room, excluding gas, water and electricity.
